description: This Java class 'ReportMailingJobValidator' provides validation logic for creating and updating report mailing jobs within the Fineract infrastructure. It handles JSON input validation, email address validation, and checks for proper date formats, ensuring correctness before processing report mailing job requests.

classes.name: ReportMailingJobValidator
classes.description: A validator component for validating report mailing job creation and update requests, including JSON structure, email validation, and date formatting.

methods.name: validateCreateRequest
methods.description: Validates the JSON request payload when creating a new report mailing job, checking for required fields, proper formats, and value constraints.

methods.name: validateUpdateRequest
methods.description: Validates the JSON request payload for updating an existing report mailing job, with similar checks as create validation but accommodating optional fields.

methods.name: isValidEmail
methods.description: Checks if a given email string matches a standard email regex pattern, indicating validity.

methods.name: validateEmailRecipients
methods.description: Parses a comma-separated list of email addresses, validates each, and returns a set of valid email addresses.

methods.name: validateStretchyReportParamMap
methods.description: Validates and parses a JSON string representing stretched report parameters into a HashMap.

methods.name: throwExceptionIfValidationWarningsExist
methods.description: Throws an exception if the list of validation errors is not empty.
